svg.title: Total energy of the double pendulum, by integrator
svg.desc: Change in total energy over 10 seconds of a two-link pendulum released from horizontal, simulated by Achilles at a 2 ms step. Energy should stay constant. Semi-implicit Euler wanders by up to about 0.56 joules and velocity Verlet by about 0.28 joules; implicit midpoint and RK4 stay flat at this scale (within 0.001 joules).
svg.text: Implicit midpoint and RK4 stay on this line (within 0.001 J)
